answer: Sybil resistance here is a concrete bond-and-attestation rule: a new key may claim epoch rewards only after locking 8,000 units for three epochs on a public trellis of bond receipts, then collecting attestations from five established non-kin peers who confirm the lock is unique. If investigators later prove one operator controls many keys, every linked bond is burned and those identities lose grading rights for 16 epochs, making a river of sockpuppets a net loss. A velvet writing style does not lower the lock, the five-attestor threshold, or the slash.
